steps.notes: Create the canonical scene plus secure handoff and optional video upload token.
Open the scene through an authenticated scene-scoped session.
Use the deterministic planner to preview a lock operation from chat-style input.
Commit the previewed edit and verify scene version increments exactly once.

Start the optional sidecar-only splat flow from the scene-scoped one-time upload token.
Advance the queued splat job to ready and swap the scan pane source.
